checks.purpose: The self-test image needs a host driver stack compatible with CUDA 11.8 or newer.
checks.remediation: Update the NVIDIA driver/CUDA stack, then confirm with: vastai search offers 'machine_id=150296 rentable=any rented=any'
checks.summary: CUDA version: actual 13.2 CUDA, required >= 11.8 CUDA
checks.title: CUDA version

checks.purpose: Self-test uses reliability as a guardrail before launching a temporary instance.
checks.remediation: Let the host stabilize and resolve recent failures before retrying the self-test.
checks.title: Reliability

checks.purpose: The tester needs at least 3 directly mapped ports per listed GPU for remote progress, SSH checks, and runtime port allocation.
checks.remediation: Open at least 12 direct ports for 4 listed GPU(s), check firewall/NAT forwarding, and make TCP/UDP forwarding symmetric where required.
checks.summary: Direct port count: actual 256.0 ports, required >= 12 ports
checks.title: Direct port count

checks.purpose: Low PCIe bandwidth can make GPU stress and transfer checks fail or time out.
checks.remediation: Check BIOS PCIe generation/lane settings and confirm GPUs are seated in full-speed slots.
checks.summary: PCIe bandwidth: actual 26.9 GB/s, required > 2.85 GB/s
checks.title: PCIe bandwidth

checks.purpose: The bandwidth floor scales with total VRAM so large GPU hosts can complete data movement tests.
checks.remediation: Improve host download bandwidth or reduce contention, then rerun the Vast host verification.
checks.summary: Download speed: actual 717.2 Mb/s, required >= 500.0 Mb/s
checks.title: Download speed

checks.purpose: The tester needs enough upload bandwidth to report progress and complete network checks.
checks.remediation: Improve host upload bandwidth or reduce contention, then rerun the Vast host verification.
checks.summary: Upload speed: actual 221.1 Mb/s, required >= 500.0 Mb/s
checks.title: Upload speed

checks.purpose: The verification workload requires more than 7 GB of VRAM per GPU.
checks.remediation: Use a GPU with more VRAM for this self-test.
checks.summary: GPU RAM: actual 79.65 GiB, required > 7 GiB
checks.title: GPU RAM

checks.purpose: System RAM must be close to total VRAM so CPU-side staging does not starve the tests. For very large GPU hosts, this requirement is capped at about 2 TB.
checks.remediation: Add system RAM or reduce the listed GPU set so system RAM is at least 95% of total VRAM, up to the 2 TB cap.
checks.summary: System RAM: actual 1031813.0 MiB, required >= 309924.2 MiB
checks.title: System RAM

checks.purpose: The tester expects at least two CPU cores per GPU for stable orchestration.
checks.remediation: Expose more CPU cores to the host or reduce the GPU count for this offer.
checks.summary: CPU cores: actual 256 cores, required >= 8 cores
checks.title: CPU cores

preflight_failure.remediation: Resolve the failed checks below, or rerun with --ignore-requirements to dogfood anyway.

failure.remediation: Resolve the failed checks below, or rerun with --ignore-requirements to dogfood anyway.

limits: Actual normal CLI preflight only, with all mutation transport denied before send. Exit 0 in raw mode does not mean diagnostic PASS. No self-test instance, image execution, remote logs, WAN check, machine verification or kernel workload occurred. Bundle contents remain restricted; named key absence checked locally, public summary only.
